records.text: Owens corrects her prior statement: the Chelsea & Casey Baugh Entrepreneurship Institute is in the Keller Building at UVU, directly next to the lot, rather than the Woodbury Building.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Foremost, I have to issue a quick correction. You know, we strive to be correct. I was live searching yesterday and I misspoke and I wrongly asserted when we were talking about Chelsea (Chelsea Baugh) and Casey Baugh, the Entrepreneurship Institute that I said was in the Woodbury Building at UVU. ... We were wrong. I meant to say that it's located in the Keller Building at UVU, which is the building that is directly next. ... The building that I should have said was the Keller Building, which is directly next to the lot, and yet I said Woodbury.
